systems.country_label: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale, du Bilinguisme et de la Promotion Civique (GPE finance; UNESCO and UNICEF technical support)
systems.tiers: Equipment handed over on 15 June 2026 to the planning and school-map divisions of seven provincial education delegations and to central directorates (human resources, examinations, learning assessment, higher-education statistics); no school-level use stated

note: About USD 550,000 of GPE-financed computers, servers and tablets handed to provincial delegations and central directorates on 15 June 2026 for the modernisation and decentralisation of the SIGE; the document does not say what the SIGE records or who enters it, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
